feature: Report ad-hoc HST: Hirer/Driver Furnished dan Alternative Address Furnished (GET /v1/hst/reports/hirer-driver-furnished dan /reports/alternative-address)
type: Kode ada tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Dua endpoint menghasilkan Excel dari ocms_furnish_application yang digabung dengan ocms_hst (daftar hirer/driver HST dan alamat alternatif yang di-furnish). Controller dan komentar saya baca; isi query di HstAdHocReportServiceImpl dan repository hanya saya lihat sekilas. Tidak ada pemanggil di ocmsadminui (grep hirer-driver-furnished, hst/reports kosong). Mungkin dicakup story 20.14, 20.15, atau 20.24 milik agent lain.
note_en: Two endpoints produce an Excel file from ocms_furnish_application joined with ocms_hst (HST hirer/driver list and furnished alternative addresses). I read the controller and its comments; the query inside HstAdHocReportServiceImpl and the repository I only skimmed. There is no caller in ocmsadminui (grep for hirer-driver-furnished and hst/reports is empty). It may be covered by stories 20.14, 20.15 or 20.24 held by other agents.

feature: Furnish approval otomatis memasang atau mencabut TS-HST per notice (furnish ID ada di daftar HST, atau offender HST diganti non-HST)
story: Tidak jelas (kemungkinan epic furnish atau sibling epic 20)
type: Kode ada tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Saat furnish disetujui (eService atau staff), jika ID hasil furnish ada di ocms_hst maka TS-HST dipasang ke notice itu; jika offender lama HST dan yang baru bukan, TS-HST dicabut untuk notice itu saja. Dipakai sebagai salah satu jalur 'notice baru ikut ditahan' di OCMS20.19. Tiket OCMS-DF-2026-092 dan OCMS-DF-2026-093 menyangkut alur ini.
note_en: When a furnish is approved (eService or staff), if the furnished ID is in ocms_hst then TS-HST is applied to that notice; if the old offender was HST and the new one is not, TS-HST is lifted for that notice only. Used as one of the 'new notices are also held' paths in OCMS20.19. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-092 and OCMS-DF-2026-093 concern this flow.

feature: Antrian bulanan ID HST ke MHA/DataHive dan penyimpanan hasil alamat (HST Monthly Query)
story: Kemungkinan OCMS20.21 (kirim ID ke ICA/DOS setiap X hari dan terima alamat), milik agent lain
type: Kode ada tanpa story di chunk ini
note: Cron bulanan memasukkan semua ID HST ke ocms_adhoc_nro_temp, file enquiry MHA/DataHive membawanya, hasil disimpan di ocms_temp_unc_hst_addr. Interval-nya jadwal bulanan tetap, bukan parameter 'every X days' seperti kata story 20.21. Dipakai sebagai sumber report di OCMS20.20. Tiket OCMS-DF-2026-125 dan OCMS-DF-2026-126.
note_en: A monthly cron puts all HST IDs into ocms_adhoc_nro_temp, the MHA/DataHive enquiry file carries them, and the results are stored in ocms_temp_unc_hst_addr. The interval is a fixed monthly schedule, not an 'every X days' parameter as story 20.21 says. Used as the data source of the report in OCMS20.20. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-125 and OCMS-DF-2026-126.
